meta.description: Completed decompilation of the US release of Parasite Eve 2 on the Playstation 1.

commit.message: The gallery Pierce requires the shooting gallery, and an actor package is decoded in the images its requires make resident: the room it requires (room.home), and the stage overlay that room requires (room.resident follows requires transitively). ActorImages is folded into Images (an optional actor package, own image first) and actor_room is gone, with the older pe2pkg-with-entries path: an actor with events is a package in an actor slot. Pierce's and the gallery's decoded data are unchanged. Step 6 of local/package_type_design.md. (Correction to f920caf851: the stage-1 maps' remaining non-stage owner= lines include task tables under older names, such as gActor101100Tasks, besides player clips and areas)
